qualityGate.reason: The Playwright tests compile and use Playwright APIs correctly. All generated test cases are present and include proper asynchronous awaits for assertions. Selectors are specific and consistent, using data-test attributes which is a good practice. The navigation check uses a regex to verify URL change which is acceptable, though it could be more precise. Test titles preserve testCaseIds. There are no hard-coded waits or unnecessary objects. Overall, the tests are executable and maintainable with strong selectors and assertions.
